programs.title: Europe From Above 4
programs.desc: The Old Continent seen from an extraordinary perspective.A bird's eye view will allow you to discover architectural treasures as well as natural gems.Europe will also be shown during different seasons.

programs.title: Heartland Docs, Dvm: Season 4
programs.desc: The next adventures of Ben and Erin - veterinarians who run a veterinary clinic.They have a lot of work because they are committed to helping animals, putting their whole heart into it.

programs.title: Something Bit Me! Compilation Season
programs.desc: The creators of the program will talk about the most terrifying animal attacks on people.The characters in subsequent episodes needed medical help due to stings, bites, infections and wounds, often life-threatening.Viewers will learn, among others:a waitress who encounters the world's largest predator on her way home, and a surfer who returned to the shore with a strange bite.In addition to the accounts of the victims, they will also hear comments from experts who will talk about the nature of wild animals and the causes of their aggression.They will also provide a scientific analysis of the facts, helping you understand the motivations of the attacking creatures.

programs.title: Growing up Animal
programs.desc: Viewers meet adolescent animals of various species from distant corners of the world.They will see how they develop in the mother's womb, come into the world and struggle with the first challenges in life.

programs.title: Incredible Dr. Pol 10
programs.desc: Another season of hard work by Dr. Jan Pol and his colleagues.The team will need a new member because Dr. Emily is expecting a baby and someone will have to replace her.

programs.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol 8
programs.sub_title: A brush, toothpaste, a cup... and a horse
programs.desc: Doctor Pol and his team help animals in need.The veterinary clinic staff will face many challenges, such as creating a hoof prosthesis or helping stressed cows.

programs.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol 10 Compilation
programs.desc: A reminder of the greatest moments and critical situations.The vet and his team meet unusual patients, deal with complicated cases, and experience touching moments.

programs.title: Killer Safari: Big Cat Battle Compilation Season
programs.desc: Tourists hope to be able to take photos of the big cats.Meanwhile, they witness an elephant charging.Leopards fight for territory.Cheetahs must face crocodiles, and a lone lion must face a herd of buffaloes.

programs.title: One Strange Rock
programs.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken in, among others, the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed.

programs.title: Tiger Queen of Taru
programs.desc: The orphaned tigress Maya lives in the Tadoba Andhari Tiger Reserve.It fights not only with its brethren, but also with cyons - mammals similar to dogs.He also tries to raise his offspring.

programs.title: Animal Fight Club
programs.desc: There is a constant struggle in the animal kingdom.Lions, elephants, polar bears and cobras engage in deadly fights.The cameras capture scenes full of tension, drama and determination.Each fight has a story behind it.An alligator boldly wanting to assert its dominance, a hungry bear fighting for food, or a fox taking part in a mating ritual - they will show their capabilities.Unique recordings show the colorful and cruel world of animals.Tactics, hidden weapons, deception - wild creatures use all possibilities and will stop at nothing to survive.

programs.title: The Wild Sides
programs.desc:
The creators of the three-part series follow the fate of several families of wild animals living in the Mashatu reserve in Botswana.The production was created over two years and presents the fate of four species.Around the bed of the dried river there are a pride of lions, elephants, a leopard, jackals with offspring, and playful baboons.Every day, these creatures fight to survive and raise their offspring in difficult conditions, and their fates are inextricably linked.Macquele the leopard is a single mother who must deal with the presence of hyenas, lions and jackals, as well as a troop of baboons giving her away her position every time she hunts.A herd of elephants led by Ukwethemba searches for food and water, covering long distances.For the young Abancane elephant, life on the move is not easy.Jackals are monogamous.The male and female of this species raise their offspring together.To find food for them, they must face much larger predators.Baboons are smart, cunning and cause trouble wherever they go.Among them are Umusa and her son
The creators of the three-part documentary follow the adventures of the inhabitants of the Mashatu reserve in Botswana, which is a wildlife enclave.The heroes of this action-packed story are families of leopards, elephants, jackals and baboons.They lead different lifestyles and have different survival strategies, but their fates are closely intertwined.The cameras captured scenes of carefree play of the young ones, as well as tense moments when the animals' lives were at stake.For two years, the filmmakers observed the challenges posed to the fauna by the extreme weather conditions prevailing in this part of Africa.Survive the drought The first part of the documentary story focuses on the fight for survival while waiting for rain.One of the heroines is Macquele the leopard, who raises her daughter alone.The problem for her is not only the lack of water and food, but also the threat from hyenas, lions and jackals.Drought is also deadly for elephants, which are said to have no natural enemies in the animal world.However, they use their own methods to reach the water.Thanks to them, other species also increase their chance of survival.The filmmakers also observe conflicts in a troop of baboons.It turns out that these smart and cunning monkeys often get themselves into trouble.
